calls.call: Price finishes 2026 with more half-PPR points than Walker.
calls.rule: Total half-PPR points, Weeks 1 through 17. No games-played adjustment; if either one gets hurt, that is part of the call.

calls.call: Purdy averages more half-PPR points per game than Daniels in 2026.
calls.rule: Half-PPR points per game, Weeks 1 through 17, minimum ten games for each. Per game rather than total because the whole argument is about who is better when he plays, not who stays upright.

calls.call: From Week 9 on, Sadiq is a top-8 tight end in half-PPR points per game, and he out-produces Mason Taylor over that stretch.
calls.rule: Half-PPR PPG among tight ends, Weeks 9 through 17, minimum six games. Top-8 is the bar, and he has to out-score Taylor per game over the same weeks. Both parts have to hit.

calls.call: A top-24 receiver from the week he comes back.
calls.rule: top-24 WR in half-PPR PPG from the week he returns through Week 17
